metadata.description: Small sub-agents that condense token-heavy chores, each with the skill that teaches when to use it.

plugins.name: run
plugins.description: Runs one exact command in the terminal's shell under a mandatory timeout and returns a short report.

plugins.name: find
plugins.description: Searches the codebase and returns paths, lines and a short answer.

plugins.name: diff
plugins.description: Summarizes the changes between two files, directories or revisions.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Answers a question about git history or state (who changed a line, when, what a commit did, current status) with commits as evidence.

plugins.name: svn
plugins.description: Answers a question about Subversion history or working copy state (who changed a line, when, what a revision did, current status) with revisions as evidence.

plugins.name: csh-pro
plugins.description: Verified csh and tcsh reference: bash-to-csh translation and pitfalls.
